reviews.text: Have been bringing our dog there for grooming for years. Our recent visit was a nightmare. No one told us the original owner who our dog loved, had sold out. We lost all our reward points as they changed the computer system. Then the new guy tells us the fees have changed, charged us double what we normally pay. After 3 hours our dog comes out looking terrible. Some  nails were trimmed, some not touched. Her underbelly was messy as was her tail. We had to send her back to the groomer to be cleaned up. Never going back there again.

I used to have a completely different opinion of this place.

A few months ago, I started bringing my Pomeranian here, and the experience was excellent. The customer service was great, the staff treated my dog with care, and she always came out looking beautiful, relaxed, and happy. It was a place I genuinely trusted.

Unfortunately, my most recent visit was the complete opposite.

It appears that the business has changed ownership and staff, and the difference was immediately noticeable. When I picked up my dog, she was extremely nervous, visibly scared, and desperate to leave. I had never seen her react that way after a grooming appointment before, which was very concerning to me.

Her haircut was also poorly done. The fur around her backside was cut extremely short and unevenly, almost as if she had been accidentally shaved in that area.

To make matters worse, I was charged approximately 40% more than what I had paid in the past.

I want to be very clear: I have no issue paying a higher price if the service, quality, and care justify it. My dog’s safety and well-being matter far more to me than the cost. But paying significantly more while receiving worse service and picking up a frightened dog is completely unacceptable.

This was easily the worst experience I have had at this location, and it is especially disappointing because this used to be a place I trusted and highly appreciated.

I sincerely hope the new management takes this feedback seriously and makes changes, because based on this experience, I would not feel comfortable bringing my dog back.
Excellent service and budget friendly too

*******
We’ve been coming here for almost 2 years now and at our most recent visit they gave our dog one of the worst cuts we’ve ever gotten and also cut him near his rear end, he ended up scabbing up and was incredibly uncomfortable for a week. We were very clear and explicitly asked for what we usually ask for. They even assured us they had reference photos and notes of the blade number and cut style from his history on file. When we picked him up and told them that we did not like his cut they completely disregarded us. We had gone for another cut a few months back when they also cut him in the same area but we gave them the benefit of the doubt because I understand it is not easy to groom dogs. However the at most recent visit (July), it was not the usual staff that works there. Hopefully not a recent change in management. Will definitely be proceeding with caution the next time I make an appointment. Unfortunate because we’ve recommended EzPaws to so many people whenever he used to be complimented on his grooming.

***** seems like other people in the neighborhood have had similar recent experiences
Excellent place, good service.

This groomer recently went under new management and I've been incredibly disappointed both times I've been. The old groomers were fantastic and the owners were attentive. However, now a days there's been a lack of attention to detail and general carelessness.

Both times we took our dog in to get groomed he looked nothing like the reference photo we sent from our previous grooms. The first time I was more understanding as a new groomer needs to work out the quirks but the second time was frankly unacceptable.

I had dropped my dog off and told the guy at the desk and groomer to match the photo and to leave the nails alone if needed, and if they try to cut the nails please only do shallow cuts and avoid the quick. I stressed repeatedly as my dog has had terrible experiences with groomers hitting his quick in the past. When I went to get my dog, not only did he not match the reference photo, but upon inspection I found his paw wet and his right dew claw entirely cut off with remnants of blood clotting powder.

Were they ever going to tell me this or were they just hoping I wouldn't find out? Not only is hitting a dog's quick extremely painful but I also warned them about this going into the appointment. And to not even tell the customer what happened is ridiculous.

In the end, the guy at the desk didnt even have the decency to come out and apologize for the harm and errors.

This place used to be great but with a lot of their best groomers gone and new management I would highly recommend taking your business elsewhere.

I love this place.  Why?  A fabulous friendly owner and a self service wash your boy for $30.00 unless you purchase the 5 pack plan.  5 for $125.00 such a great deal.  They supply the tub, shampoo, towels and the dryer.  My Mambo sheds so much that Its too messy and stressful at home to bath him.  Here I gave him the perfect luxurious bath!! Buy the 5 pack for $125 you just can not go wrong.  Mambo loved it too!!!

I had such a great experience with Eze Paws and will be bringing my dog here from now on! I’ve brought my adopted senior dog and my foster dog here to get their first grooming, and they went over the top.

The staff is so friendly, responds quickly, and makes scheduling super easy. One of my favorite things is that they’re cage-free and don’t overbook appointments. Because of that, the grooming appointments are quick and our pups don’t spend half the day waiting in a kennel. It gave me so much peace of mind knowing they were being cared for instead of just sitting and stressing in a cage

You can really tell they care about the dogs and take pride in their work. I highly recommend Eze Paws!
Had a great experience. Concierge was very knowledgeable and very helpful . Already booked  my next visit.

Fabulous grooming for my silver toy poodle. Just perfect style. Such a fabulous owner and groomer, very warm and friendly. You won't be disappointed. They also have a point system. Such cozy and very clean atmosphere.
John and Sacha always take such great care of my dog.  Their grooming services are comprehensive one price all inclusive. They do great work. I highly recommend them.

Absolutely beautiful work
My fur baby looks like a stuffed animal
The staff is amazing
I’ve been bringing Chloe here since they first opened, and I’ve always loved their work. You can really tell they care for the dogs. Highly recommend!
Melie, my Maltese, is always happy and peppy when she visits EZ Paws. This is Melie after her visit with the dental hygienist. The second picture is Melie after she has been groomed.

Our chihuahua had never had a professional teeth cleaning. The vet wanted to sedate him. His teeth were so bad. Half hour at Eze Paws and his teeth are clean and beautiful. No sedation necessary and he was such a good boy.  Reasonable price. Thank you. We will be back!
The care they give my Lucky is amazing. Safe and very clean establishment.
Just had my dog groomed. Fabulous job!! In & out in 2 hours…no waiting. We’ll define LH be returning in a few weeks.

What an amazing place! They took my puppy in right away because they had openings and were so accommodating and wonderful! Plus they did a great job this is definitely our new spot to be groomed!

Ecxellent job with my dog, thank you so much
Fantastic place. Professional, caring, knowledgeable , reasonable pricing. Have been going there for over a year. Everything is always perfect. Could not ask for more
Great place for my dogs haircuts friendly staff knowledge on types of haircuts would recommend.Business is kept very clean.
I cant say enough about this establishment.  They are very professional,  yet warm. They do such a great job with my my dogs. My dogs get so exited when we come here.
E-Ze Paws is just the best! Sasha and her team do the best groomings with love and care for your fur babies!
Eze Paws is very convenient to wash your dog! Washing your dog at home is back breaking and makes a mess. So happy I found this plalce. Its clean and the owners are very nice!!! I highly recommend!
Leo is always happy & comfortable when I leave him  to get groomed. He always looks beautiful when I pick him up! Highly recommend this place!
Very friendly and they take very good care of the dogs
Very friendly and professional service! 💯 recommend
EZ Paws are always on time w their appointments and do an excellent job grooming our 12 year old border collie mix

They are so wonderful with our dogs! They come out so beautiful and happy. I recommend them highly. I’ve used other places before and my dogs come out traumatized. So happy to have a place that cares for them with love.

We love the way our 4 yr old Pluto Bigon mix turned out. Perfect depth of cut and fluffy and so soft. It did take awhile but well worth the wait. We'll be back for sure.

Back again I am very happy with the service I have received for Pluto. Has turned out great again. Thank you all for being very accommodating all the time
Last minute appointment very grateful. Great Job to all
I always bring my fur baby to Eze paws they are caring and wonderful

Sadie looked fantastic after her grooming appointment. Her coat was smooth, clean, and neatly trimmed. The groomer handled her gently, kept her comfortable, and paid attention to the small details. She came home happy, calm, and smelling great. Overall, a reliable and caring grooming experience.
Nice place clean they do a nice job
Absolutely the best groomers around! They cared for my dogs as if they were their own. Sasha cried with me when I lost my dog, Sparkles, and cared for Zeus during his first grooming as a rescue.
Happy with the service, thank you for everything
Nice and professional, they listen to what you tell them, always a great cut. I take both my dogs. Highly recommend!
Great job! Professional pleasant team, modern updated equipments. Thanks!
They care about your pets and are great with customers requests

I am so happy to have found a place my dog Brownie allows the groomer to trim and buff his nails without howling through it all. This is the 2nd time Brownie has gotten his nails trimmed from Charlie and this will be the ONLY place I take him. I actually took my dog to the vet today and didnt get his nail trimmed there just so we can go straight to Charlie at Eze Paws for it.

Thank you guys so much. We are a loyal customer to stay. 😊

Johnny was patient and understanding. He took the time to go over everything we wanted for our Shih Tzu Gracie..when she came out she looked amazing. They did everything they said they would do and more!! Thank you for making Gracie look amazing!!! Thank you!!
Excellent❤️
My Nelly was so scared going in for her first ever grooming, but Eze Paws took good care of her and she came out smelling great!
Highly recommended very professional

A pleasure to work with the kind and knowledgeable people at Eze Paws. We have been coming to see Sasha for a few years now with my
Labrador retriever Luna. Always considerate, thorough, and gentle with my girl! Highly recommend!
Very inviting establishment. Staff was extremely helpful and professional will definitely be back and request additional services

I chose them because my mom recommended them after their incredible patience with her nervous (and very large) Bernese.

It was way scarier than I thought handing over my little baby dog- but boy was I pleased when I picked up my fresh little puff ball an hour later.

If you’re on the fence about them- don’t be- they handled by baby with love and care! Looking forward to a long lovely relationship with them!
Thank you!
Very warm, welcoming and friendly.
Thank you!

The staff SUPER helpful and professional. We took our two dogs for self wash. They provided instruction, towels , shampoo and conditioner. They oriented us on how to use the blow dryer for the dogs. The experience was very easy. The difficulty was my dogs not wanting to get in the tub. LOL

Thank you so much John for the 5 star review!

My dog has a lot of very long hair and always needs a lot of work, but he loves his groomer so that tells me what I need to know. Highly recommend.
Thank you so much!

What a great place for Dog Grooming.

This was our first time using Eze Paws and we are so happy that we did. Amazing job!! Our dog looks great!

It’s clear they go above and beyond to make both pets and owners feel comfortable. I’ll definitely be bringing my dog back here and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy groomer!

When I called Sasha in a panic that my dog had skin cancer, and we needed to shave him down to check him out, she immediately got me in. We have been long time clients and I would never go elsewhere. They also have a great variety of toys and treats, and self service dog wash tubs. There is no better place.

I couldn’t be happier with the grooming services here! From the moment we walked in, the staff was warm, welcoming, and clearly passionate about what they do. They took the time to listen to my requests and made sure my pup felt comfortable throughout the entire process.
Easy fast bathe and dry self service with bonus, they also provide supplies: apron, shampoo, towels and cleanup! Very accommodating. Very nice and calm environment!

Always so happy with Eze-Paws , they do an excellent job each and every time!  I highly recommend them,  every grooming session we received a consultation  They are patient and kind,  Kali comes home smelling  amazing and her cut is adorable!
